arxiv-2008-09418.title: METHOD TO CLASSIFY SKIN LESIONS USING DERMOSCOPIC IMAGES
arxiv-2008-09418.creator: Dusa Sai Charan, Hemanth Nadipineni, Subin Sahayam, Umarani Jayaraman
arxiv-2008-09418.description: Abstract Skin cancer is the most common cancer in the existing world constituting one-third of the cancer cases. Benign skin cancers are not fatal, can be cured with proper medication. But it is not the same as the malignant skin cancers.

arxiv-2010-06203.title: Mitigating Gender Bias in Machine Translation with Target Gender Annotations
arxiv-2010-06203.creator: Artūrs Stafanovičs*, Toms Bergmanis*, Mārcis Pinnis
arxiv-2010-06203.description: Abstract When translating “ The secretary asked for details. ” to a language with grammatical gender, it might be necessary to determine the gender of the subject “ secretary ”. If the sentence does not contain the necessary information, it is not always possible to disambiguate.

arxiv-2102-08708.title: A Dataset and Benchmark for Malaria Life-Cycle Classification in Thin Blood Smear Images Journal: Neural Computing and Applications
arxiv-2102-08708.creator: Qazi Ammar Arshad 1, Mohsen Ali 1, Saeed-ul Hassan 1, Chen Chen 2, Ayisha Imran 3, Ghulam Rasul 4, Waqas Sultani 1
arxiv-2102-08708.description: Abstract Malaria microscopy, microscopic examination of stained blood slides to detect parasite Plasmodium , is considered to be a gold-standard for detecting life-threatening disease malaria. Detecting the plasmodium parasite requires a skilled examiner and may take up to 10 to 15 minutes to completely go through the whole slide.

arxiv-2106-07846.title: Cluster-guided Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Person Re-Identification
arxiv-2106-07846.creator: Mingkun Li, Chun-Guang Li, and Jun Guo
arxiv-2106-07846.description: Abstract Unsupervised person re-identification (Re-ID) aims to match pedestrian images from different camera views in an unsupervised setting. Existing methods for unsupervised person Re-ID are usually built upon the pseudo labels from clustering. However, the result of clustering depends heavily on the quality of the learned features, which are overwhelmingly dominated by colors in images.

arxiv-2206-02961.title: The ϕ ​ p \phi p bound state in the unitary coupled-channel approximation
arxiv-2206-02961.creator: Bao-Xi Sun, Ying-Ying Fan, Qin-Qin Cao
arxiv-2206-02961.description: Abstract The strong attractive interaction of the ϕ \phi meson and the proton is reported by ALICE collaboration recently. The corresponding scattering length f 0 f_{0} is given as R ​ e ​ ( f 0 ) = 0.85 ± 0.34 ​ ( s ​ t ​ a ​ t ) ± 0.

arxiv-2304-11283.title: Gate-tunable phonon magnetic moment in bilayer graphene
arxiv-2304-11283.creator: Xiao-Wei Zhang, Yafei Ren, Chong Wang, Ting Cao, Di Xiao
arxiv-2304-11283.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiao-Wei Zhang, Yafei Ren, Chong Wang, Ting Cao, Di Xiao. We develop a first-principles quantum scheme to calculate the phonon magnetic moment in solids. As a showcase example, we apply our method to study gated bilayer graphene, a material with strong covalent bonds. According to the classical theory based on the Born effective charge, the phonon magnetic moment in this system should vanish, yet our quantum mechanical calculations find significant phonon magnetic moments.

arxiv-2304-14370.title: Heisenberg Limit beyond Quantum Fisher Information
arxiv-2304-14370.creator: Wojciech Górecki
arxiv-2304-14370.description: Abstract The Heisenberg limit provides a fundamental bound on the achievable estimation precision with a limited number of N N resources used (e.g., atoms, photons, etc.). Using entangled quantum states makes it possible to scale the precision with N N better than when resources would be used independently.

arxiv-2308-00007.title: Effects of ϕ \phi and σ ∗ \sigma^{*} -meson on properties of hyperon stars including Δ \Delta resonance
arxiv-2308-00007.creator: Chen Wu 1 and Wenjun Guo 2
arxiv-2308-00007.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chen Wu 1 and Wenjun Guo 2. In this work, we research the properties of neutron stars using the nonlinear Relativistic Mean-Field (RMF) theory and consider multiple degrees of freedom inside neutron stars, including hyperons and Δ \Delta resonances. We investigate different coupling parameters x σ ​ Δ x_{\sigma\Delta} between Δ \Delta resonances and nucleons and compare the differences between neutron stars with and without strange mesons σ ∗ \sigma^{*} and ϕ \phi .

arxiv-2509-14614.title: The countable condensation on linear orders
arxiv-2509-14614.creator: Jennifer Brown, Ricardo Suárez
arxiv-2509-14614.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jennifer Brown, Ricardo Suárez. The countable condensation on a linear order L L is the equivalence relation ∼ ω \sim_{\omega} defined by declaring x ∼ ω y x\sim_{\omega}y when the set of points between x x and y y is countable. We characterize the linear orders L L that condense to 1 1 under the countable condensation by constructing a linear order U U that is universal for the order types L L such that L / ∼ ω ≅ 1 L/\!\!\sim_{\omega}\,\cong 1 .

arxiv-2601-04472.title: Silicon photonic optical–electrical–optical converters based on load-resistor and current-injection operation
arxiv-2601-04472.creator: Masaya Arahata, Shota Kita, Akihiko Shinya, Hisashi Sumikura, Masaya Notomi
arxiv-2601-04472.description: Abstract Optical–electrical–optical (OEO) converters are key primitives for low-latency, energy-efficient photonic computing because they enable nonlinear activation and optical signal regeneration on chip. We report two monolithically integrated silicon-photonic OEO converters—load-resistor (high-speed variant) and current-injection (high-gain variant) types—fabricated at a silicon photonics foundry. Each device combines a germanium photodetector with a micro-ring modulator (MRM).

arxiv-2602-13808.title: An End-to-End Agentic Pipeline for Smart Contract Translation and Quality Evaluation
arxiv-2602-13808.creator: Abhinav Goel, Chaitya Shah, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo
arxiv-2602-13808.description: Abstract We present an end-to-end framework for systematic evaluation of LLM-generated smart contracts from natural-language specifications. The system parses contractual text into structured schemas, generates Solidity code, and performs automated quality assessment through compilation and security checks. Using CrewAI-style agent teams with iterative refinement, the pipeline produces structured artifacts with full provenance metadata.

arxiv-2605-14136.creator: Nurislam Tursynbek, Zhiqiang Lao, Heather Yu, Gedas Bertasius, Marc Niethammer, UNC Chapel Hill, Futurewei Technologies Inc, UCSD nurislam@cs.unc.edu, {zlao,hyu}@futurewei.com

pmc-11595996.title: Management of a Rare Case of Superior Mesenteric Artery Aneurysm Associated with a Pancreatic Cyst Complicated by Acute Rupture: A Case Report and Review of Literature
pmc-11595996.creator: Petru Razvan Dragulescu, Roxana Carmen Geana (Anghel), Mircea Robu, Reza Nayyerani, Cristian Dumitrescu, Anca Dragan, Catalin Vasilescu, Vlad Anton Iliescu, Ovidiu Stiru
pmc-11595996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Superior mesenteric artery aneurysms are a rare pathology, and rupture due to a pancreatic cyst in the context of alcohol-induced pancreatitis is an even rarer condition. The first line of treatment is usually an endovascular approach. We present the case of a 51-year-old male with alcohol-induced pancreatitis, diagnosed with a superior mesenteric artery aneurysm with active bleeding in close contact with a large pancreatic cyst. A covered stent was used to treat this condition.

pmc-11639731.title: Rheology of paste-like food inks for 3D printing: Effects of nutrient and water content
pmc-11639731.creator: ZY Bugday, A Venkatachalam, PD Anderson, RGM van der Sman
pmc-11639731.description: This research delves into understanding the effects of composition on the rheological response of multi-component food inks for 3D food printing. Accordingly, the motivation is to decouple the nutrient and water content effects on the rheology. We formulated inks by combining pea fractions with water and employing a water-holding-capacity based hydration method.

pmc-11696431.title: Exploring the Dynamic Coordination Sphere of Lanthanide Aqua Ions: Insights from r2SCAN-3c Composite-DFT Born–Oppenheimer Molecular Dynamics Studies
pmc-11696431.creator: Emiliano Isaías Alanís-Manzano, C I León-Pimentel, Laurent Maron, Alejandro Ramírez-Solís, Humberto Saint-Martin
pmc-11696431.description: Born–Oppenheimer molecular dynamics (BOMD) simulations were performed to investigate the structure and dynamics of the first hydration shells of five trivalent lanthanide ions (Ln3+) at room temperature. These ions are relevant in various environments, including the bulk aqueous solution. Despite numerous studies, accurately classifying the molecular geometry of the first hydration sphere remains a challenge.

pmc-12646187.title: Assessing inhabitants’ satisfaction and service needs: a cross-sectional survey of primary care service in Jiangsu Province, China
pmc-12646187.creator: Wenjun Yan, Vorapoj Promasatayaprot, Sumattana Glangkarn
pmc-12646187.description: Background:Primary care serves as the foundation of a well-functioning healthcare system and is critical for ensuring equitable access, early disease management, and cost-effective service delivery. In China, reforming primary-level healthcare institutions has become a national priority to achieve universal health coverage.

pmc-13167331.title: Advances in Immunotherapy for Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Focus on PD-1/PD-L1 Blockade and Beyond
pmc-13167331.creator: Fei Le, Youfang Jiang, Yaoyao Chen, Xianming Huang, Qian Ouyang, Saiping Lü
pmc-13167331.description: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) ranks as the seventh most common cancer globally, with etiological subtypes—carcinogen-driven (human papillomavirus [HPV-negative]) and HPV-driven—shaping tumor immunogenicity and treatment responses. This review highlights immunotherapy’s evolution, focusing on PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. HPV-positive tumors feature a “hot” microenvironment with dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) and PD-L1 upregulation, yielding better immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) outcomes.

pmc-13301737.title: Predictors of atrial fibrillation recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation: a single-center experience
pmc-13301737.creator: A Uslu, M S Belpinar, A Kup, M Celik, K Gulsen, S Demir, D Sen, O E Zoroglu, B Bozan
pmc-13301737.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence remains a major limitation of catheter ablation. Identifying predictors of recurrence may improve patient selection and long-term rhythm outcomes.PurposeTo evaluate clinical, echocardiographic, and procedural predictors of AF recurrence after radiofrequency ablation in a single center.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 480 patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation with contact-force guided RF ablation.

pmc-13536319.title: Epigallocatechin gallate in dentistry: Therapeutic applications, biomaterial integration, and translational challenges
pmc-13536319.creator: Chloe Jui-Yun Chang, Fang-Yu Fan, Yung-Li Wang, Thi Thuy Tien Vo, Yang-Che Wu, Yu-Chia Chang, I-Ta Lee
pmc-13536319.description: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), a major bioactive catechin in green tea, has attracted increasing attention in dentistry because of its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, matrix-modulating, and regenerative properties. This narrative review summarizes current evidence on the biological mechanisms, dental applications, and translational challenges of EGCG in oral healthcare.

pmc-13671430.title: Targeting tumor-selective membrane-associated PCNA enables selective antibody–drug conjugate therapy
pmc-13671430.creator: Muhammad Abu Ahmad, Nir Miriam Ungar-Malma, Alon Naumchik, Noy Machluf-Katz, Olga Radinsky, Sarah Adi Eisdorfer, Abedallh Gara, Yosef Istoyler, Irit Alon, Daniel Sevilla-Sanchez, Kerry S. Campbell, Bar Kaufman, Moshe Elkabets, Angel Porgador
pmc-13671430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Membrane-associated proliferating cell nuclear antigen (mPCNA) is an attractive tumor-selective antigen for antibody–drug conjugate (ADC) development. We generated a chimeric IgG1 ADC, RC14-MMAE, to exploit three key properties of mPCNA that support its use as an efficient delivery platform. First, flow-cytometric and imaging analyses show abundant mPCNA surface expression on multiple tumor cell lines and in JIMT1 xenografts, providing accessible epitopes for binding.

pmc-13688856.title: ClinNetDx: a novel explainable ai framework for acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection using multi-modal clinical data
pmc-13688856.creator: Muralidhar Muthukumaran, Prabu Selvam, Prasantha Bharathi Dhandapani, Nirmala Veeramani, Rebecca Muhumuza Nalule, Gokulnath Vetrivel, Samy R Mahmoud, Afaf S Alwabli
pmc-13688856.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Early identification of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) is vital to respond on time; yet, presently existing diagnostic procedures still depend on laboratory knowledge, manual interpretation and many supplementary exams. This paper introduces ClinNetDx, a new hybrid deep learning model for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia prediction that combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Deep Neural Network (DNN) and employs structured blood test data and (optional) medical images to support good health and well-being.
